# slashskills

> Portable, practical Agent Skills from real projects.

slashskills is an open library of reusable SKILL.md workflows for coding agents and chat-based AI tools. Each skill is a self-contained folder with instructions and, when useful, scripts, references, and assets.

## What it is for

- Founders and developers who want repeatable AI-assisted workflows.
- Coding-agent users working in Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor.
- Chat users who want reusable planning, writing, launch, and analysis workflows.

## Key pages

- [Skill directory](https://www.slashskills.xyz/): Browse all skills and copy an install command.
- [Compatibility](https://www.slashskills.xyz/compatibility): Runtime support and required capabilities for every skill.
- [Changelog](https://www.slashskills.xyz/changelog): Recent product and library updates.

## Representative skills

- [remove-ai-slop](https://www.slashskills.xyz/remove-ai-slop): Audit and improve AI-generated product copy and interfaces.
- [gtm-launch](https://www.slashskills.xyz/gtm-launch): Plan a product launch and distribution.
- [seo-ready](https://www.slashskills.xyz/seo-ready): Implement technical SEO and AI-search foundations.
- [aeo-ready](https://www.slashskills.xyz/aeo-ready): Improve answer-engine discoverability with clear, structured content.
- [pitch-vc](https://www.slashskills.xyz/pitch-vc): Prepare a startup fundraising pitch.
